title: Forethought Solve Context Variable
description: A context variable available in a Forethought Solve workspace. Context variables are values passed into a Solve conversation to personalize responses or drive workflow branching.

context_variable_id.description: Stable identifier for the context variable.

display_name.description: Human-friendly variable label as shown in the Solve workbench.

is_predefined.description: True for variables built into Solve; false for workspace-defined variables.

context_variable_type.description: Data type of the variable's value.
